findings.text: Upheld (Q2, logic duplicated). Checked: repo.ts:679-689 in learnAliases and repo.ts:1106-1114 in revertInterrupted contain the same lease rule. If the store already holds the repository's lease, the step runs directly. Otherwise it runs under withRepoLeases, and only a KnowledgeError with code 'locked' is swallowed. This is a branch plus an error classification, so it is logic and not boilerplate. The direct branch exists so that a lost outer lease's 'locked' is not swallowed, and neither copy says so. A change to that rule must be made in both places. One helper would do.
Kept as advisory (Q10): the comment names six white-space characters. CONFIG_SPACE and the class in CONFIG_HEADER list five, because \n is removed by the line split, and the comment does not say so.
Kept as advisory (Q5/Q2, boilerplate): the refuse closure in checkRepoConfig has one caller, the throw repeats its message tail, and the white-space class is written twice.

Kept as advisory (Q10): the comment on diff.ignoreSubmodules=all and submodule.recurse=false claims more than these settings do. probes/submodule-layers.md confirms the setting alone does not hold against a .gitmodules with ignore = none. Only the --ignore-submodules=all flag does.
Kept as advisory (Q8): INTENT_OPERATIONS and ownPath are exported and nothing imports them. The rubric grades an unused export advisory.
Kept as advisory (Q2, boilerplate): refuseForeign repeats the lstat and 'a link' / 'not a ...' refusal several times.
Kept as advisory (Q2, boilerplate): an inline lstat isDirectory check now that isDirectory is exported from repo.ts.
Kept as advisory (Q2): foldersByHand and projectFolders still copy resolve.ts's folder listing. Carried.
Kept as advisory (Q2): adopt repeats underLeases's lease nesting. Carried, and graded advisory in rounds one and two.

Kept as advisory (Q4/Q5): GitOptions.timeoutMs, resolveRepo's folderName and DoctorContext.gitVersion are knobs only tests set. The minimum git version is formatted differently in checks.ts and in requireGit. Carried.
Kept as advisory (Q8): moduleVersion and readEntry are exports only tests import. Carried.
Lowered to advisory, debt: the line is outside the change. The diff repeats the db as Db pattern at checks.ts:614.

Kept as advisory (Q1). probes/submodule-layers.md confirms the reviewer's reading on git 2.54.0. With no .gitmodules, the -c diff.ignoreSubmodules=all setting alone keeps git out of the nested repository, so the test stays green if only the --ignore-submodules=all flag is dropped. It fails only when both layers are dropped. The flag alone holds against a .gitmodules with ignore = none, and openRepo refuses that file, so the uncovered case is reached only by a .gitmodules that appears mid-operation. The fix as a whole is held. submodule.recurse=false is held by no test.
Kept as advisory: the init.defaultObjectFormat and init.defaultRefFormat pins pass with or without the settings on git 2.54.0, whose defaults already match. No criterion names the pin.
Kept as advisory: no test adds a file during commit's git add and commit. That window is a stated known limit (ADR 0024). Carried.
Kept as advisory (Q5): the rebuild-order test depends on the internal renewal count. Carried.
Kept as advisory (AC-8): only the version probe times out at this level. Carried.
Kept as advisory (AC-8): 'killed' is checked only through the 'timed out' message. Carried.
Kept as advisory (AC-2): the parent-status check is weak. The environment test holds the ceiling guard. Carried.
Kept as advisory (AC-13): clipping is checked on the thrown message, not on the log line. Carried.
Kept as advisory (AC-2): the gained-remote test resolves through the row and not the manifest. Carried.

Upheld (Q1, boundary; breaks AC-15 and AC-19). Checked: supportPaths puts .template, .no-hooks and .gitconfig-empty directly under knowledge/. ensureSupportFolders (repo.ts:79-86) accepts whatever is already there: mkdirSync recursive on an existing folder, and existsSync keeps an existing file. These paths are then used as core.hooksPath (repo.ts:301), as GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL (repo.ts:284) and as git init --template (repo.ts:605), and checkRepoConfig never reads any of them. probes/security-round-three-findings.md ran all three cases on git 2.54.0, and the program ran in each. (a) A dropped .no-hooks/pre-commit runs on the store's commit. (b) A dropped .gitconfig-empty with a filter and core.attributesFile runs the filter on writeEntry, and the write completes. (c) A dropped .template config plus info/attributes runs the filter during createRepository, before checkRepoConfig refuses the repository. Who: anyone who can drop a file under <data dir>/knowledge/. What they get: a program run under the person's identity on any write.

Upheld (Q1, boundary; breaks AC-19). Checked: ownPath (repo.ts:854-861) tests only the text of a path. refuseForeign checks only the top-level folders. stateOf follows a leading link. undoStaged then runs rmSync(join(repo.path, path)), which follows a link one level under entries/. probes/security-round-three-findings.md case F-2 (i) ran it on git 2.54.0: with entries/sub linked to an outside folder, an intent-to-add index entry and a crafted intent record, statusOf lists the path, git rm --cached --ignore-unmatch exits 0, openRepo returns, and the person's file outside the repository is deleted. Variant (ii), with a regular index entry, deletes nothing but leaves every command on that repository failing. Who: the same dropper. What they get: deletion of a known file outside the store.
Kept as advisory (hardening): readIntent and restoreKept read dropped files with readFileSync, which follows a link, has no size cap and blocks on a FIFO. readRegularFile would close this.
Kept as advisory (defence in depth): .git/objects/info/alternates is not refused. No program runs and nothing leaves the machine, but it should be refused before sync lands.

Kept as advisory (Q1/Q3): one refused repository (for example, one with a hand-added remote) makes unscoped list, adopt and rebuild fail for every repository. A refused workspace repository blocks every project write. Nothing is lost: the message names the setting and the file, doctor warns, and --scope still works. The spec's risks section should say so.

Kept as advisory: ALLOWED_SETTINGS holds only core.*. The later sync part must widen it and ship that change with the code that writes the new settings, and ADR 0024's later-parts section does not say so. This is about a future item, not a defect of this one.

Kept as advisory: a record readIntent rejects is removed with no report, and its kept-bytes file stays under .git/. Only a record the store did not write, or a rare path ownPath refuses, reaches this case. No content is lost.

Kept as advisory: for an adopt, the 'was undone' message also lists paths that were only unstaged. The tree is right and the sentence overstates. Round two's two defects-turned-advisories here are closed.

Kept as advisory: the module migration pass is not contained, and doctor does not warn when the module schema is behind. Stated as a known limit. The as-string cast at db.ts:296 fails loudly where it used to write an empty name.
Kept as advisory: the rollback is stated with its reason but is manual, and the pre-drop backup rotates away under BACKUPS_KEPT = 2. Carried.
Lowered to advisory, debt: it names no line of the diff and sits outside the change. The lint gate processing 0 files in a worktree checkout is a tooling problem. A manual run covered this item.
Lowered to advisory, debt: the p95 hook-latency flakiness predates this item and names no line of the diff.
Lowered to advisory, debt: the upgrade runner's 10 s wait under BEGIN IMMEDIATE predates this item.
Kept as advisory (Q6): the function-level import cycles repo-resolve and repo-author remain, and resolve.ts's isDirectory import widens the first. They are safe at runtime. Carried.

Kept as advisory: doctor now runs refuseForeign and checkRepoConfig in openRepo's order, which closes round two's boundary effect. It still copies that guard sequence by hand, builds a store with db as Db and lists the folders itself. spec.md:268 allows reading by hand, but CLAUDE.md:22 says openRepo is the one way. Either export one read-only guard or note the exception.

Kept as advisory: the spec's Design still describes a refusal list and an older set of -c settings, and it lacks the .gitmodules, nested-repository, ownPath and kept-bytes rules. ADR 0024 records each one and declares itself the later text. None crosses a boundary.
Kept as advisory: the ADR's list of -c settings omits diff.ignoreSubmodules=all and submodule.recurse=false, which configArgs now passes.
Lowered to advisory, debt: outside the change. SettingKey omits two keys that SETTING_KEYS holds.
Lowered to advisory, debt: outside the change. It has no forward reference to ADR 0024.

Kept as advisory (Q3): settle takes the fingerprint after the write's git calls, so a file added in that window is counted and not read. Stated as a known limit (ADR 0024). The file stays on disk and doctor and adopt surface it. Carried.
Kept as advisory (Q1): the drop is irreversible, with a stated reason and a backup first. The backup rotates under the two-backup limit. Carried.
Kept as advisory (Q6): a one-time VACUUM INTO under the write lock on stores that ran the withdrawn module. Stated. Carried.
Kept as advisory (Q2): project_aliases is read by project_id with no index, now twice per learning open. The table is small and the read is off the hook path.

Kept as advisory (Q3): learnAliases rewrites and commits knowledge.json with no intent record. A kill in between leaves the change for adopt to credit to the person. The alias is correct and nothing is lost.

Kept as advisory (Q5): kept bytes written before writeIntent names them, or named by a record readIntent rejects, stay under .git/ with nothing to remove them. ADR 0024's erasure steps do not mention them. The window is narrow.
Lowered to advisory, debt: the missing project_id index on project_aliases predates the change.
